static_traits.name: Li Ming
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems occurred before; has not received psychotherapy; no notable physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, fairly cooperative, calm tone, capable of self-reflection, with occasional self-reproach and 'should'-style statements

basic_info.main_problem: Whenever I miss one workout or have not yet achieved my fitness goals, I feel terrible about staying in shape, and therefore feel guilt and inferiority.
basic_info.core_demands: These feelings of guilt and inferiority are affecting my mental health and self-esteem, making it difficult for me to enjoy the activities I like (such as walking in the woods); I hope to reduce these negative emotions and enjoy life again.
growth_experiences: About a year ago started focusing more on fitness goals, and set unrealistic strict goals based on fitness influencers on social media; since then increased stress, intensely blaming myself whenever missing a workout or eating unhealthy food, with comparisons to others (influencers) lowering self-evaluation; tried different training and diet plans, but the sense of guilt persists.

core_beliefs: I am a failure / not good enough
Only perfectly achieving a goal has value; otherwise it is failure

special_situations.event: Missing one gym workout (e.g. not yet having gone to the gym yesterday)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot complete workouts strictly according to plan, it means I am a failure, and may even ruin all previous progress
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Setting stricter goals or doubling training and controlling diet, trying to prove oneself with higher standards
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am terrible at keeping in shape; this time it is all ruined again

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not fully follow the diet plan, it means I lack self-control and am not worthy of achieving my fitness goals
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Further tightens diet and rules, avoiding any eating behavior that 'deviates' from the plan
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not disciplined; doing this means I have failed completely

special_situations.event: Seeing fitness influencers' training and diet displays on social media
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I must meet their standards or even higher to count as qualified; otherwise it proves I am inferior
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Copies influencers' training and diet plans wholesale and constantly compares himself with them
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They can all do it easily, but I cannot; I am a failure

special_situations.event: While out for a walk or other leisure, thinks 'I should be training at the gym'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any behavior deviating from the plan is not allowed; I must keep training at all times, otherwise I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Compresses or cancels leisure activities, turning all time and attention to the training plan
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should be at the gym right now; otherwise I am not disciplined

core_conflict.wish: Longing to gain recognition and self-esteem through discipline and meeting standards, becoming a 'qualified/worthy' person
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being seen as a failure, as inferior, and thus losing self-worth
defense_goal: Maintains control and a sense of safety with strict self-demands and high standards
Avoiding exposing vulnerability and shame to others (not talking with friends about fitness struggles) to avoid negative evaluation

object_relations.object_representation: The perfect 'other' who sets high standards and is daunting (social-media influencers/role models)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether they have shared fitness troubles with close friends, or when thinking about confiding in friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If exposing weaknesses leads to being looked down upon or feeling humiliated, it is best to suppress it and not speak
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use brief, factual answers, reducing emotional words and details, with a steady tone, avoiding deep emotional expression.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When strictly set fitness or diet goals are not yet achieved
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Directing the anger and disappointment triggered by comparison and high standards toward oneself (oneself not being good enough)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expressing in a self-reproaching tone (e.g. 'it is all because I am no good'), frequently using negating labels, lowering willingness to seek external support.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When encountering influencers' training / diet standards and setting goals based on them
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Incorporating the outside world's high standards and evaluations into self-demands without digesting them
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizes 'should/must' rules, cites others' standards as the basis for self-judgment, in a hard but tense tone.

manifestations: Viewing leisure time (e.g. walks) as a deviation that is not allowed
Internalizing others' standards as the basis for self-judgment
outcomes: Loses the sense of autonomy and flexibility in choosing
Difficulty experiencing the present and enjoying life

manifestations: Has close friends but unwilling to share fitness struggles, feeling embarrassed and ashamed
outcomes: Emotional burden hard to externalize and be empathized with

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Copying influencers' training and diet standards as the basis for judging oneself
Treating meeting the standard as the only acceptable outcome

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Persistent self-criticism and labeling after missing workouts
Overly focused on mistakes while ignoring progress
Worries about 'disappointing' self, thus hesitates to adjust goals

positive_force: Has motivation and willingness to keep improving oneself
Capable of some self-reflection (proposed the idea of recording progress)
Has a close friend to confide in (though not yet shared fitness struggles)
Loves and longs to return to healthy leisure activities such as nature walks
negative_force: Comparing with influencers and seeking external validation
Often uses 'should/must'-style rules to restrict myself, ignoring flexibility and positive evidence

target_behavior.behavior: Intense guilt and self-denial after missing workouts or eating unhealthy food (emotions + self-talk)
antecedent: Browsing fitness influencer content on social media
Setting and recalling strict goals not yet achieved
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalizing the outside world's high standards as the sole criterion for self-judgment, and catastrophizing and interpreting a single mistake in all-or-nothing terms
target_behavior.function: Maintaining the illusion of 'control and discipline' through self-punishment and harsh reproach, temporarily avoiding the anxiety of admitting the goals are unrealistic
target_behavior.consequence: Lowered self-esteem, increased stress and anxiety, difficulty enjoying leisure activities like walks, overall quality of life impaired

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding sharing fitness struggles with close friends (social avoidance)
antecedent: Thinking of or being advised to confide in friends about fitness-related pressure and troubles
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being looked down upon or judged after exposing vulnerability, avoiding help-seeking out of shame
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential negative evaluations and humiliation, maintaining a surface self-image
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced social support, increased loneliness, the problem cycling persistently and hard to alleviate
